title: LAST STAND Apocalypse
description:
STORYOn a prison planet overrun by hordes of monsters, ten sexy female heroes find themselves isolated and in a desperate, hopeless situation.

They must endure endless waves of monster attacks for dozens of days, gather resources to strengthen themselves, and hold out until the rescue fleet arrives.

Defeat in battle plunges them into the abyss of deep despair… but victory brings sweet, tantalizing rewards.

Experience the tension of survival alongside intense immersion and thrilling stimulation.

GAMEPLAYThis is a Vampire Survivors-style roguelite action game. With a fixed top-down view and gameplay that only requires movement (auto-firing), the controls are extremely accessible with almost no barrier to entry.

The game features a day-night cycle. Defeat monsters that swarm at night to collect crystals, then in the morning visit the shop to freely purchase and upgrade weapons and items without restrictions.Weapons possess six different elements. Specific combinations grant powerful buffs, allowing you to create diverse builds and playstyles.

Choose from 10 playable characters. Each has her own unique difficulty level and signature abilities, offering a wide variety of playstyles.

Fully 3D animated scenes with free camera control, optional hiding of the male performer, clothing on/off toggles, and more.

Pseudo-ASMR experience featuring whispered dirty talk to encourage ejaculation. Total runtime approx. 19 minutes. Three different first-person movies.

FEATURES• Thrilling Roguelite Experience

Hundreds of weapon fusions, random shops, countless build possibilities, and high replayability. 

• Simple Controls

Pure Vampire Survivors-like gameplay — anyone can pick it up and play instantly. 

• Substantial Content

Multiple playthroughs offer over 7 hours of total gameplay. 

• 3D Dynamic H Scenes

Rich animated CG rewards for both defeat and victory. Enjoy a wide variety of erotic scenes — including pregnancy processes — fully voiced and with free camera angles.
